name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.59-beta “Paris” (build 60): Vis citations and your paragraph sign.
• Choose ¶ or “para.” for citations — in Settings ▸ Citation, and per matter. Update Exhibits from Brief re-renders the brief in the new sign.
• Vis matters cite as published memoranda do — [Exhibit C 1, p. 10, para. 5] — and the List of Authorities reads Cited as | Authority | Cited in.
• Indexes: treaties, books and articles are no longer set in italics; the Jessup index sorts by the full reference.
• Fix: bracketed citations no longer gain an extra “]” when updated.
